title: SWAP5 Documentation & Review Baseline

publication_risk.interpretation: Publishing main as current SWAP5 review authority would publish a stale source relative to integration/f-ci-canonical.
publication_risk.required_resolution: Create an explicit frozen review publication authority and make the site identify its scientific and documentation git authorities.

authority_chain: theory_or_scientific_contract -> production_code -> owner_qualification -> independent_qualification_where_required -> canonical_admission -> permanent_preservation
next_actions: Persist reviewer entrypoint and frozen-baseline pages.
Add them to MkDocs navigation and make the homepage reviewer-first.
Inventory the scientific-model and numerical-formulation source authorities needed for complete narrative documentation.
Populate science and numerics sections without inventing claims not supported by theory/code/evidence authorities.
Reconcile publication branch/source so GitHub Pages never presents stale main as current authority.
Run repository docs check and mkdocs build --strict.
Publish only after the frozen review authority is explicit and externally verifiable.
explicit_nonclaims: F-DOC20 does not modify scientific production code.
F-DOC20 does not broaden Status-A capability scope.
F-DOC20 does not claim whole-model SWAP4.3.1/SWAP5 equivalence beyond existing evidence.
F-DOC20 does not treat ongoing post-Status-A development as part of the frozen review denominator unless explicitly admitted before freeze.
